BEFORE  HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE GAJENDRA SINGH  ON THE 6 th OF AUGUST, 2025  CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 549 of 2011  JAYRAM  Versus  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH  Appearance:
 None for the appellant.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Shri Rajesh Joshi - learned Govt. Advocate for the res  ORDER This Criminal Appeal under Section 374(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 is preferred challenging the judgment dated 29.04.2011 in Sessions Case No.477/2010 by the Additional Judge,
(Fast Track) to the Court of Sixth Additional Judge, Ujjain whereby appellant/accused has been convicted under Section 376(1) of the Indian Penal Code and sentenced to undergo 10 years R.I. and fine of Rs.500/- & Section 450 of the Indian Penal Code and sentenced to undergo 05 years R.I. and fine of Rs.200/- with default stipulation of 1 year and 6 months additional R.I.
2.

This appeal arises out of the incident dated 23.07.2010 in which appellant committed sexual intercourse with the prosecutrix against her will and regarding which a Crime No.312/2010 was registered at Police Station Makdone, Ujjain.

3. The PUD No.2935/Warrant/2025 dated 28.06.2025 of NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:21074 2 CRA-549-2011 Superintendent, Central Jail - Ujjain mentions that the appellant/accused has been released on 03.08.2018 after completing the sentence and depositing the fine amount.

4. Perusal of the prosecution evidence and judgment of the trial Court does not discloses any error in appreciation of evidence and conviction of the appellant/accused, hence, the conviction is affirmed.
The sentence is proportionate and that has been undergone, accordingly, no case for interference in the sentence is required.
5. In view of the aforesaid, this criminal appeal is dismissed.
6. Copy of the order along with record be sent to the concerned trial court for information.
